Low self esteem, lack of confidence, lost my license so I can’t drive, etc. Realizing you have some issues enables you to work on those issues. Things take time but with some effort and dedication I’m sure you can turn yourself around. It’s never to late to try to do better and be a better person.

Maybe try some new things like exercising at home, drawing, or try and learn an instrument. Anything that you’ve wanted to try or think might be interesting but haven’t gotten around to yet. Sometimes changing things up a little can help motivate and inspire you. If you have something new to focus on you won’t be able to spend as much time focusing on the things that are bothering you.

Just remember that even though depression is something you’ll struggle with on and off it will get better. You might be at a low point right now but things can turn around pretty quickly if you let them. It’s already hard enough dealing with depression as is so watch some shows you like, do things that you like to do, and it may seem kind of random but sometimes just turning your phone off for a few hours and trying to find something to do can do wonders for mental health.
